enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed in Bedroom 2. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed with body still. Turn over occasionally under the sheet. Breathe steadily while asleep. Remain in bed for the full segment until 06:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, brushing teeth and taking a quick cool shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk from Bedroom 2 to the Bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the shower tap. Step into the shower. Wet body under the water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Rub the towel over face, arms and torso. Hang the towel back on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water from the tap. Turn off the tap. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with toast and tea from the kettle, checking the morning news, and having breakfast with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Bathroom to the Kitchen. Turn on the Kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out bread and milk. Close the refrigerator door. Place the bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Fill the kettle with water. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Scroll through the morning news on the phone. Put the phone down on the counter. Pick up the toasted bread from the toaster. Place the toast on a plate. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into a mug. Put a tea bag into the mug. Sit down at the table. Eat the toast with hands. Lift the mug and drink the tea. Turn head toward Member 1. Say 'Good morning, did you sleep okay with the fan on?' Listen to Member 1's reply. Continue eating the toast. Drink the remaining tea. Stand up from the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, applying sunscreen for the heatwave, packing a work bag and reviewing the day's schedule under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Kitchen to Bedroom 2. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt and trousers. Take off the sleepwear. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Close the wardrobe door. Pick up the sunscreen bottle from the shelf. Open the cap. Squeeze sunscreen onto the palm. Rub sunscreen over face, neck and arms. Close the cap. Put the sunscreen bottle back on the shelf. Pick up the work bag. Open the bag zip. Place a laptop into the bag. Place a notebook and pens into the bag. Place a water bottle into the bag. Close the bag zip. Sit down at the desk. Press the desk lamp switch on. Pick up the phone. Open the calendar app. Read the day's schedule on the phone screen. Put the phone down on the desk. Press the desk lamp switch off. Stand up. Pick up the work bag. Walk out of Bedroom 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the arts centre for work, keeping to the shaded side of the street because of the extreme heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the house. Turn onto the street. Walk along the shaded side of the street. Cross at the crossing. Continue walking on the shaded pavement. Step around pedestrians on the pavement. Stop at the traffic light. Wait for the light to change. Cross the road. Continue walking toward the arts centre. Wipe sweat from the forehead with the back of the hand. Adjust the work bag strap on the shoulder. Reach the entrance of the arts centre. Pull open the entrance door. Step inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Arts administration work at the arts centre: answering emails, preparing grant reports and coordinating the upcoming exhibition schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk at the arts centre. Sit down on the chair. Press the computer power button. Type the login password on the keyboard. Open the email application. Read new emails. Type replies on the keyboard. Click send. Open a grant report document. Type text into the document. Open a spreadsheet. Enter budget figures into the spreadsheet cells. Save the document. Open the exhibition schedule file. Review the exhibition dates on the monitor. Pick up the phone. Dial a colleague's number. Speak into the phone about coordinating the exhibition schedule. End the call. Put the phone down. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Collect printed pages. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. File the printed pages into a folder. Continue typing email replies. Save all open files.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at a cafe near the arts centre and cooling down in the air conditioning
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk. Push the chair in. Walk out of the office. Walk along the pavement to the cafe. Pull open the cafe door. Step inside. Walk to the counter. Read the menu board. Order a sandwich and a cold drink. Pay with the card. Take the receipt. Walk to a table. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Unwrap the sandwich. Eat the sandwich. Lift the glass and drink. Wipe the mouth with a napkin. Stand up. Push the chair back in. Carry the tray to the counter. Walk to the door. Push open the door. Step outside. Walk back toward the arts centre.

enriched_activities.activity: Afternoon arts administration work: staff meeting, drafting artist contracts and planning exhibition installation logistics
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the arts centre. Walk to the meeting room. Sit down at the meeting table. Open the notebook. Take notes with a pen during the staff meeting. Speak about the exhibition installation logistics. Listen to colleagues. Close the notebook. Stand up. Walk back to the desk. Sit down on the chair. Open the artist contract template on the computer. Type names and dates into the contract. Print the contracts. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Collect the contracts. Walk back to the desk. Sign the contracts with a pen. Place the contracts in a folder. Open the installation logistics plan. Type the equipment list into the file. Save the file. Stand up. Push the chair in. Pick up the work bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking home from the arts centre in the late afternoon heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the arts centre. Turn onto the street. Walk along the shaded side of the street. Stop at the traffic light. Wait for the light to change. Cross the road. Continue walking home. Wipe sweat from the forehead with the hand. Shift the work bag to the other shoulder. Step around pedestrians. Stop at the second crossing. Cross the road. Walk the remaining stretch to the house. Reach the front door. Open the front door. Step inside. Close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower to freshen up after the hot commute
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the entrance to the Bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the shower tap. Step into the shower. Wet the body under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over arms, torso and legs. Rinse the body under the water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Rub the towel over the head, face and body. Hang the towel on the rack. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 1 using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Kitchen. Turn on the Kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables and meat. Close the refrigerator door. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables. Push the vegetables aside. Cut the meat into pieces. Place a pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the meat to the pan. Stir the meat with a spatula. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir the mixture. Press the oven button on. Place a tray of food into the oven. Close the oven door. Take two plates from the cupboard. Place the plates on the table. Turn off the induction cooker. Take the tray out of the oven. Place the food on the plates. Sit down at the table with Member 1. Pick up the fork. Eat the dinner. Lift the cup and drink water. Say to Member 1 'Can you help me with the dishes after?' Put the fork down. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and loading the dishwasher with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the plates from the table. Carry the plates to the sink. Scrape food scraps into the bin. Rinse the plates under the tap. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Place the plates into the rack. Place the forks and knives into the cutlery basket. Pick up the pans. Wash the pans with a sponge under the tap. Place the pans into the dishwasher rack. Push the lower rack in. Add dishwasher detergent to the dispenser. Close the dishwasher door. Press the dishwasher start button. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Wring the cloth over the sink. Hang the cloth on the hook. Turn off the Kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on freelance illustration commissions at the desk with the computer, monitor and desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Kitchen to Bedroom 2. Open the door. Walk to the desk. Sit down on the chair. Press the desk lamp switch on. Press the computer power button. Press the monitor power button. Type the login password on the keyboard. Open the illustration software. Open the current commission file. Pick up the stylus. Draw lines on the drawing tablet. Zoom in on the canvas. Change the brush size. Draw details on the illustration. Save the file. Open a new layer. Draw shading on the illustration. Save the file again. Pick up the phone. Check messages on the phone. Put the phone down. Continue drawing with the stylus. Save the file. Close the illustration software. Press the monitor power button off. Press the computer power button off. Press the desk lamp switch off. Stand up. Push the chair in.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioner running to escape the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from Bedroom 2 to the Living Room. Pick up the air conditioner remote. Point the remote at the air conditioner. Press the power button on the remote. Press the temperature down button. Put the remote down on the sofa. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote. Press the TV power button. Press the channel button. Watch the TV screen. Lean back on the sofa. Cross the legs. Pick up the TV remote. Change the channel. Put the remote down. Stand up from the sofa. Pick up the remote. Press the TV power button off. Put the remote down. Walk out of the Living Room.

enriched_activities.activity: Night-time wash up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Living Room to the Bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet the hands under the water. Pick up the face wash. Squeeze face wash onto the palm. Rub the face wash over the face. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Bathroom to Bedroom 2. Open the door. Walk to the bed. Sit down on the bed. Pick up the book from the bedside table. Open the book. Read the pages. Turn a page. Read the next page. Close the book. Put the book down on the bedside table. Stand up. Press the desk lamp switch on. Walk to the light switch. Press the light switch off. Walk back to the bed. Lie down on the bed. Pull the sheet over the body. Close eyes.
Lie on the bed in Bedroom 2. Keep eyes closed. Remain still under the sheet. Turn over once. Continue lying in bed asleep until 24:00.
